changelogEntry1:
- The reading page adds a display filter left of flag inference for dialogue, inner voice, narration and lore; it affects story text only, leaves battle cards intact, and resets on reload.
- A tri-state fold button sits right of the display filter: it expands or collapses all options and condition branches at once, collapsing when everything is open, expanding when everything is closed, and following the expanded majority otherwise; battle cards stay untouched.
- The catalogue rail is laid out like a printed contents page, with chapter and script totals, ordinals, colour marks, per-chapter counts and clearer expand arrows.
- Rail search is kept when switching tabs, its hint now reads "Filter scripts…", and matches are counted while searching.
- Bookmark delete buttons appear only on hover or focus and sit further inside the row.
- Branch hover previews are gone from the reader; branches open on click.
- The masthead shows only the game version, dropping the generation time and build number, and the search box is centred over the reader column.
- Talent changes read as learned or forgotten with the level always positive.
- "Scene script / combat event" markers are gone from the reader breadcrumb and rail entries, along with the filter's source field and its system and scene kinds.
changelogEntry2:
- The reader shows a character portrait and expression left of the speaker name, with a settings toggle and size control.
- A local framing workbench (pnpm framing) pans and zooms the avatar frame per character and expression with a live mirrored preview; the result is written to data/portrait-framing.json and reused by every extraction, while untouched expressions keep the default crop.
